verses.zh: 喜爱管教的，就是喜爱知识；恨恶责备的，却是畜类。
verses.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.en: Loving to be taught means loving to learn; hating correction is like being an animal.

verses.zh: 善人必蒙耶和华的恩惠；设诡计的人，耶和华必定他的罪。
verses.kjv: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.en: A good person is shown kindness by the LORD, but he judges anyone who makes sly plans.

verses.zh: 人靠恶行不能坚立；义人的根必不动摇。
verses.kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.en: Nobody stands firm by doing wrong, but a good person's roots will never be moved.

verses.zh: 才德的妇人是丈夫的冠冕；贻羞的妇人如同朽烂在她丈夫的骨中。
verses.kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.en: A capable wife is her husband's crown, but a shameful one is like rot in his bones.

verses.zh: 义人的思念是公平；恶人的计谋是诡诈。
verses.kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.en: Good people think about what is fair; bad people's plans are full of tricks.

verses.zh: 恶人的言论是埋伏流人的血；正直人的口必拯救人。
verses.kjv: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.en: Bad people's words lie in wait to hurt others, but honest people's words rescue them.

verses.zh: 恶人倾覆，归于无有；义人的家必站得住。
verses.kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.en: Bad people are knocked over and gone, but a good person's house keeps standing.

verses.zh: 人必按自己的智慧被称赞；心中乖谬的，必被藐视。
verses.kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.en: A person is praised for how wise they are, but a twisted heart is looked down on.

verses.zh: 被人轻贱，却有仆人，强如自尊，缺少食物。
verses.kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.en: Better to be nobody special and have a servant than to act important and have no food.

verses.zh: 义人顾惜他牲畜的命；恶人的怜悯也是残忍。
verses.kjv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.en: A good person cares about their animals, but even the kindness of bad people is cruel.

verses.zh: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食；追随虚浮的，却是无知。
verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.en: Whoever works their own field will have plenty to eat, but chasing empty things shows no sense.

verses.zh: 恶人想得坏人的网罗；义人的根得以结实。
verses.kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.en: Bad people want what other bad people have caught, but a good person's roots produce fruit.

verses.zh: 恶人嘴中的过错是自己的网罗；但义人必脱离患难。
verses.kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.en: A bad person is trapped by their own sinful talk, but a good person gets out of trouble.

verses.zh: 人因口所结的果子，必饱得美福；人手所做的，必为自己的报应。
verses.kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.en: What a person says fills them with good things, and what their hands do comes back to them.

verses.zh: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看为正直；惟智慧人肯听人的劝教。
verses.kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
verses.en: A fool thinks his own way is right, but a wise person listens to advice.

verses.zh: 愚妄人的恼怒立时显露；通达人能忍辱藏羞。
verses.kjv: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
verses.en: A fool shows his anger straight away, but a sensible person lets an insult pass.

verses.zh: 说出真话的，显明公义；作假见证的，显出诡诈。
verses.kjv: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.en: Telling the truth shows what is right; a false witness shows nothing but tricks.

verses.zh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。
verses.kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.en: Careless words stab like a sword, but the tongue of a wise person heals.

verses.zh: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。
verses.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.en: True words last for ever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

verses.zh: 图谋恶事的，心存诡诈；劝人和睦的，便得喜乐。
verses.kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.en: Those who plan evil have tricks in their hearts, but those who work for peace have joy.

verses.zh: 义人不遭灾害；恶人满受祸患。
verses.kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.en: No real harm comes to a good person, but bad people are filled with trouble.

verses.zh: 说谎言的嘴为耶和华所憎恶；行事诚实的，为他所喜悦。
verses.kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.en: The LORD hates lying lips, but he delights in people who act honestly.

verses.zh: 通达人隐藏知识；愚昧人的心彰显愚昧。
verses.kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.en: A sensible person keeps what they know to themselves, but a foolish heart shouts out its foolishness.

verses.zh: 殷勤人的手必掌权；懒惰的人必服苦。
verses.kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.en: Hard-working hands will end up in charge, but lazy ones will end up doing forced work.

verses.zh: 人心忧虑，屈而不伸；一句良言，使心欢乐。
verses.kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.en: Worry weighs a person's heart down, but one kind word makes it glad.

verses.zh: 义人引导他的邻舍；恶人的道叫人失迷。
verses.kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.en: A good person guides their neighbour, but the way of bad people leads others astray.

verses.zh: 懒惰的人不烤打猎所得的；殷勤的人却得宝贵的财物。
verses.kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
verses.en: A lazy person does not even cook what he caught, but a hard-working person treasures what he has.

verses.zh: 在公义的道上有生命；其路之中并无死亡。
verses.kjv: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.en: On the road of doing right there is life, and along that path there is no death.
